Process simulated and bulk data for TAPE

Source: R/tape.R
tape_process.Rd

Prepares simulated training data and real bulk data for TAPE model training and prediction. The function performs variance filtering, gene intersection, log transformation, and per-sample scaling.

Usage

tape_process(simudata, real_bulk, variance_threshold = 0.98, scaler = "mms")

Arguments

simudata

A list returned by [tape_simulate()] containing simulated pseudobulk expression and proportions.

real_bulk

Numeric matrix with genes in rows and samples in columns.

variance_threshold

Numeric scalar in `[0, 1]`. Fractional rank used to define the variance cutoff independently for simulated and real bulk data.

scaler

Character scalar. Either `"mms"` for min-max scaling or `"ss"` for standard scaling.

Value

A named list with components:

train_x

Numeric matrix of simulated training expression with samples in rows and genes in columns.

train_y

Numeric matrix of simulated proportions with samples in rows and cell types in columns.

test_x

Numeric matrix of processed real bulk expression with samples in rows and genes in columns.

genename

Character vector of intersected gene names.

celltypes

Character vector of cell-type names.

samplename

Character vector of real bulk sample names.

Details

The current implementation applies scaling row-wise after `log1p` transformation, matching the intended sample-wise scaling direction.

Examples


## Build a tiny single-cell reference (genes x cells) ---------------------
set.seed(1)
n_genes        <- 1000
cell_types     <- c("Tcell", "Bcell", "Mono")
cells_per_type <- 100
n_cells        <- length(cell_types) * cells_per_type

counts <- matrix(
  rpois(n_genes * n_cells, lambda = 5),
  nrow = n_genes, ncol = n_cells
)
rownames(counts) <- paste0("gene", seq_len(n_genes))
colnames(counts) <- paste0("cell", seq_len(n_cells))

meta <- data.frame(
  cell_type = rep(cell_types, each = cells_per_type),
  row.names = colnames(counts)
)
sc <- SeuratObject::CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, meta.data = meta)
#> Warning: Data is of class matrix. Coercing to dgCMatrix.

## Simulate training pseudobulks (samples x genes) ------------------------
train_sim <- tape_simulate(
  sc, celltype_col = "cell_type",
  samplenum = 50, n = 100, sparse = FALSE, random_state = 1
)
#> [00:00:00] Simulation started
#> [00:00:00] Generating Dirichlet proportions
#> [00:00:00] Sampling cells and building pseudobulks
#> 
  |                                                                            
  |                                                                      |   0%
  |                                                                            
  |=======================                                               |  33%
  |                                                                            
  |===============================================                       |  67%
  |                                                                            
  |======================================================================| 100%
#> [00:00:00] Simulation finished

## Simulate a separate set to stand in for the real bulk ------------------
test_sim <- tape_simulate(
  sc, celltype_col = "cell_type",
  samplenum = 10, n = 100, sparse = FALSE, random_state = 2
)
#> [00:00:00] Simulation started
#> [00:00:00] Generating Dirichlet proportions
#> [00:00:00] Sampling cells and building pseudobulks
#> 
  |                                                                            
  |                                                                      |   0%
  |                                                                            
  |=======================                                               |  33%
  |                                                                            
  |===============================================                       |  67%
  |                                                                            
  |======================================================================| 100%
#> [00:00:00] Simulation finished
real_bulk <- t(test_sim$X)   # tape_process expects genes x samples

## Variance filter, gene intersection, log1p, per-sample scaling ----------
processed <- tape_process(train_sim, real_bulk, scaler = "mms")
#> [00:00:00] Processing started
#> [00:00:00] Applying variance filtering
#> [00:00:00] Intersected gene number: 961
#> [00:00:00] Applying log1p transform
#> [00:00:00] Applying mms scaling
#> [00:00:00] Processing finished
